PREMISE CORRECTION: the 10-K/10-Q 'idled wind tower facility' that 'began delivering utility poles in the second quarter' (Q2 2026 10-Q) is Clinton IL (already in the ledger). Tulsa is an ACTIVE wind tower plant in transition; the 10-Q's 'plan to convert one of our existing wind tower facilities ... in 2027' names no site and is kept as an inferred trigger row only.
